## How it works

Upload your file, get a transcript in minutes, and download in your preferred format.

 

01

### Upload your file

Drag and drop audio or video. MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, MOV, and WEBM supported. No account required.

 

02

### Transcribe in minutes

Our AI engine processes your recording and returns clean text fast. Typical turnaround is under a minute for short files.

 

03

### Download TXT or SRT

Get your transcript as plain text or subtitles. Need a formatted document? DOCX export is available.

## Content factory

Lessrec can turn one recording into a complete publishing package: transcript, article, SEO page, captions, posts, and internal notes.

From raw audio to a full content pipeline

Upload a call, podcast, webinar, or interview once. We create the transcript first, then reshape it into editorial assets for search, social, support, and sales teams.

 Transcripts Clean speaker-labeled text with timestamps and searchable structure. 

 Articles Human-readable long-form pieces built from interviews, podcasts, and webinars. 

 SEO pages Brief-driven content with headings, intent, FAQs, and internal-link ideas. 

 Repurposing LinkedIn posts, email snippets, show notes, summaries, and captions. 

## Pay-as-you-go packs

Buy minutes once, use them whenever you need. No expiry, no monthly fee.

## Need human-edited accuracy?

AI transcription is fast and affordable. For court filings, medical records, or published research, our editors review every word, label speakers, and format the output to spec.

Send your file for a custom quote. Typical turnaround starts at 12 hours.

## Use cases

These stories show the practical outcome: what was difficult in the recording, what needed to be delivered, and how the transcript helped.

 

Market research

The recording had six participants and constant overlap. Lessrec separated the speakers, kept respondent language intact, and prepared the text for coding.

 

Legal consultation

The client needed exact wording with timestamps. The final document made it easy to find disputed phrases and compare them with the audio.

 

Podcast editorial team

A long episode became a clean transcript with host questions highlighted, making it faster to write the show notes and article draft.

## Output formats

Instead of abstract samples, here is what clients actually receive after the recording is transcribed and edited.

Legal-ready transcript document

Interview with timestamps

Dialogue-style meeting record

Captions and edit list

 

## FAQ

Short answers about pricing, files, and delivery.

 How much does transcription cost? + 

$0.05 per audio minute. You can buy minute packs: 100 min for $5, 500 min for $20, or 2000 min for $60. The first 10 minutes are free.

 Which files are supported? + 

MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC, MP4, MOV, and WEBM. If your file is larger than 4 GB, share a cloud link instead.

 Do minutes expire? + 

No. Purchased minutes stay on your balance until you use them. There is no monthly fee or subscription.

 Can I get SRT captions? + 

Yes. After transcription you can download TXT, SRT, or DOCX. SRT includes synthetic timecodes spread across the duration of your recording.
